dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are your plans for the future?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: The future? Hah, do I look like someone who has a future to speak of?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: ...Hey, hey, I'm just kidding. After that near-death experience, I've become extremely optimistic about the future.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: I'm done with the adventuring though. My focus should be my family for now...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: It just so happens that many of the village fields have gone barren. I'll spend my time farming and living life like the rest of the people here.
